request: 这是动漫小说，人物采用动漫风格，不要真人风格。
style: 统一二维科幻动漫风格：清晰线稿、动漫五官、赛璐璐块面阴影
narrative_stage: 第一、二卷战争初期，后期永久损伤与武器断裂前

images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: individual full-body ANIME character artwork for the original science-fiction action novel 断星纪.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET and costume/weapon/composition reference for this character. Repaint the ENTIRE image as an unmistakably HAND-DRAWN TWO-DIMENSIONAL ANIME illustration, including the person, equipment, scenery and lighting. The previous image was too realistic; anime style is the highest priority of this correction.
Style/medium: polished contemporary Japanese science-fiction action anime key visual; crisp expressive ink linework, stylized anime face construction, graphic hair clumps, simplified nose and mouth, anime eyes, flat base colors with clean two- or three-step cel-shaded shadows, beautifully drawn 2D background. All clothing and machinery rendered through drawn contours and stylized shapes. Strong authored animation character design. NO photorealistic faces, skin pores or photographic textures. NO live-action actor, semi-realistic digital portrait, 3D model or CGI render.
Composition: preserve a vertical 2:3 frame, ONE individual character, full body with boots and entire sword visible, clear silhouette and readable facial expression. Preserve the defining costume and weapon functions, but simplify excessive texture and small fittings to make a clean anime design.
Narrative stage: early-war first/second volume, before later permanent injuries and sword breakages.
Constraints: originally designed future-Earth swordsman; technology-based effects with physical nodes and connections. Retain a subdued damaged city background, rendered as drawn anime scenery. No added foreground people. No writing, names, readable signs, logo, watermark, panels, comparison layout, halos or magic glyphs.
Character: 凌烬, 断星, male about 25. A distinctly lean, long-limbed young ADULT anime swordsman with tousled short black hair, angular slender face and alert dark anime eyes. His expression is quiet determination with compassion, not cruelty. Light and mobile silhouette, dark practical field coat, fitted combat trousers and boots, restrained small armor panels.
Weapon invariant: ONE black narrow straight long sword 烬锋·照夜, simple precise industrial construction with a very fine pale cutting-energy line. Keep the blade dark and slender, not a giant glowing sword. Hold it low, angled out from the body as in the reference; relaxed but ready pose. The uncovered right hand retains a few small old grip/repair scars, drawn with minimal lines.
Visual emphasis: agile, keen observation, short-distance readiness; coat hem drawn in clear animation shapes. Repaint the face into full anime design rather than stylizing the original realistic actor face. Draw the ruined avenue and soft dawn behind him entirely in 2D cel-shaded/background-painting language.
